title: Moody narrative adventure game Goodbye Seoul takes place six months before the Earth is destroyed by an asteroid. Release set for early 2027
excerpt: The game recently got a new trailer and was confirmed for an Early 2027 release.
content:
Fans of dark post-apocalyptic (or pre-apocalyptic?) stories will likely enjoy a story as bleak as Goodbye Seoul. After the discovery of a world-shattering asteroid headed toward Earth, humanity crumbles and South Korea’s capital Seoul is left in ruins. 

The story follows Rion, a student who ventures into the city as she follows a lead to a secret space evacuation project that will hopefully get her off the doomed planet. On her journey, she encounters all sorts of survivors (many of whom are desperate and hostile) and navigates various puzzles within the dilapidated city. 

Gameplay involves a lot of hiding, running, and platforming, with Rion avoiding enemies as she solves environmental puzzles. The new trailer reveals that some chase sequences involve quick time events that you must complete to progress. In addition to combating thethreats around her, it appears that Rion is also fighting an internal battle. Her inner thoughts are represented through hallucinations of other survivors, as well as another Rion that accompanies her. 

While the game’s version of Seoul is quite bleak, some survivors you meet are friendly and will help you on your journey. As the story unfolds, Rion uncovers the truth behind the secret space evacuation project as she searches for a purpose to keep living. 

Developed by JINO Games and published by NEOWIZ, Goodbye Seoul is set to release in early 2027 for Windows (Steam). A demo is also available.
